title: The control: a procedure nobody promoted serves no goal, however often it matched
description: The app is the proving suite's FIXTURE APP: a fake harness that performs the goal's actions on the fake machine and reports each one as the cockpit does, through the same session writer a delegated app session is recorded through. It is not a provider and plays no cassette; every session it runs counts as one model reach, because an app session is the intelligence a learned procedure exists to stop paying for. The same fixture and the same evidence as the trusted scenario -- two recordings, two matches beside the app across two bindings, and the promotion proposed -- but no person decides it. The measured goal must therefore be served by the app, and the replays-without-a-model counter must read ZERO on the platform arm: a counter that read one here would be counting the absence of a model call rather than a served replay.
goal: Reconcile the weekly ledger for {{account}} and notify the operators
